issues: NOT CITED: no occurrence of \cite{hanisch} (or 'hanisch') found anywhere in texto_anpec/*.tex -- this entry is unused in the manuscript; audited anyway per instructions.

Title field is line-wrapped across two lines in the .bib source (WoS export artifact) -- reflows cleanly to one line with no wording change; content matches the published title exactly, including the colon.
Journal field is ALL-CAPS ('JOURNAL OF INTERNATIONAL MONEY AND FINANCE'), a raw WoS export convention -- should be sentence/title case: 'Journal of International Money and Finance'.

Month = {FEB} is WoS shorthand; harmless but inconsistent with the rest of the bibliography's month formatting if other entries spell out months or omit them -- worth normalizing for consistency.

Author, Year (2017), Volume (70), Pages (110-134), ISSN (0261-5606, print) all verified correct against CrossRef and RePEc -- no field mixing detected; author, title, journal, and identifiers all belong to the same single paper.
